channel.title: RoboPay blog
channel.description: News, demos and research notes from the RoboPay team at HTW Berlin.

item.title: RoboPay wins the peaq track at Crypto World’s Fair
item.description: RoboPay took first place in the peaq track of the Crypto World’s Fair Hackathon by Colosseum. FieldProof, Fiducia, SKIM and DeSC followed in places two to five.

item.title: The day the RoboPay team first met
item.description: On 10 July, Yashdeep, Kevin and Xinyan met in person for the first time and started talking about working together as one team.
